Bug_Details:
Using the standard getClassLoader() may not return the right class loader in a JEE context. Instead, go through the currentThread .
Noncompliant code example
ClassLoader cl = this.getClass().getClassLoader();  // Noncompliant
Compliant solution
ClassLoader cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where the getClassLoader() method is used to get the class loader which may not return the right class loader in a JEE context. Instead, the correct approach is to use Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() to get the class loader.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered in the showBugTest method where the getClassLoader method is used which may not return the right class loader in a JEE context. The assertNotEquals method is used to compare the returned class loader with the correct one (Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader()), and if they are not equal, the test case fails.
